messages:
incident-bot: Pager: metering anomaly detected — rate-accumulator shows fractional token drift vs ledger. auto-severity: P2. Docs: <https://runbook.internal/metering/accumulator-drift>

alice_oncall: Acked. Oncall here, starting triage.

ben_prod: Are customers getting overage flags or just internal deltas?

carla_sre: Preliminary: emitter shows small fractional increments (~0.002 tokens/sec on a subset) causing noisy rounding at aggregator -> overflag in nightly reconciliation. Repro in staging with recent emitter build.

alice_oncall: Impact estimate? any live billing alerts? @dan_billing please chime in.

dan_billing: Seeing a few manual overage emails triggered for 3 midsize customers in the last hour. Counts are +1 or +2 tokens spikes on daily totals due to rounding, not mass overbilling. Putting customer comms on hold until we confirm root cause.

carla_sre: Quick mitigation: flip accumulator to integer truncation mode (safe, will undercount by <1 token/day) and pause the fractional aggregator job. Command: `kubectl -n meter exec accumulator-0 -- /bin/sh -c \"echo trunc > /etc/meter/mode && s6-svc -r /service/accumulator\"`

alice_oncall: Do it. I'll execute and watch.

carla_sre: Done — mode=trunc applied, accumulator restarted at 1763214380. Monitoring: ingestion delta dropping to baseline.

ben_prod: Nice. Can we add a temporary reconciliation filter to suppress one-off overage notifications until full fix?

dan_billing: Yes — enabling suppression rule for alerts with delta <= 5 tokens in the last 24h for accounts flagged by anomaly detector. Enabled at 1763214435.

elaine_pm: Need quick note for support: what to tell customers if they ask? Suggested: \"We observed a minor metering variance affecting rounding on a small set of accounts. We're applying safeguards; no material billing impact. If you see unexpected charges open a ticket and we'll investigate\"

alice_oncall: Support note posted to #support-ops, tag `billing-triage`.

carla_sre: Root cause candidate: recent emitter change introduced floating aggregation when sampling low-volume streams. Repro PR: `github.com/redwood/emitter/pulls/482`. Rolling back that commit for emitter-stable-2026-03-18 to fully eliminate fractional path.

alice_oncall: Plan: 1) rollback emitter change to stable (carla), 2) keep trunc mode and suppression in place (done), 3) run full backfill validation for last 48h (ben + dan), 4) postmortem and release notes (elaine). ETA for rollback + validation?

carla_sre: Rollback started, image promoted at 1763214510. Will validate logs for 15m then promote to prod.

ben_prod: I'll kick off the backfill validation job now: `python tools/validate_backfill.py --window 48h --check rounding` — monitoring at 1763214525.

dan_billing: I'll sample the three affected accounts and confirm no material charges after suppression. Reporting to CX if anything shows.

alice_oncall: Thanks all. If rollback holds and validation green, we'll lift suppression and trunc mode tomorrow after 0600 UTC. For now leave postmortem owner as elaine.

elaine_pm: Got it — creating PM ticket and scheduling postmortem for 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Links: runbook, rollback PR, suppression rule id `suppr-1763`.

alice_oncall: Closing on-call handoff notes and returning to normal. :thumbsup:
